questions.q: What is an all-purpose cluster meant for?
options: Running exactly one scheduled job and then terminating immediately
Interactive, shared use — staying running while multiple notebooks explore and iterate against it
Only running SQL queries, never PySpark notebooks
Permanently storing Delta tables
questions.explain: This is exactly the mode every lab in Data Engineering Foundations assumed — a person, actively working.

questions.q: What happens to a job cluster's lifecycle?
options: It's provisioned automatically when a scheduled job runs, used for that one run, and terminated immediately afterward
It only exists for Unity Catalog operations, never regular jobs
It stays running indefinitely once created, just like an all-purpose cluster
It must be manually created and manually terminated by a person
questions.explain: Nobody attaches to a job cluster interactively — it exists only to execute one specific piece of work.

questions.q: Why does a job cluster typically cost less per DBU than an all-purpose cluster?
options: Job clusters are always smaller in worker count than all-purpose clusters
Job clusters use slower, cheaper hardware by default
There's no risk of it sitting idle and billing for nothing, unlike a forgotten all-purpose cluster, since its entire lifetime is one job run
There's actually no price difference between the two
questions.explain: This is a genuine, material cost difference in real production usage.

questions.q: Which scenario best fits a job cluster rather than an all-purpose one?
options: A notebook someone keeps open all day, running cells as they think of new questions
A nightly ETL job that runs the same notebook unattended, on a schedule
Multiple team members sharing one environment during active development
A data engineer actively exploring a new dataset and debugging PySpark interactively
questions.explain: The general rule: if it's meant to run unattended on a schedule, use a job cluster.

questions.q: Can a person interactively attach to and run cells against a job cluster?
options: Only if the job cluster has autoscaling enabled
Only during the first five minutes after it's created
No — a job cluster exists only to execute one specific scheduled piece of work
Yes, job clusters support the exact same interactive attachment as all-purpose clusters
questions.explain: Interactive, back-and-forth exploration is specifically what all-purpose clusters are for.
